title: Migrate rincon-common's Beads/Dolt tracker into a new Engram project
outcome: Migrate rincon-common's Beads/Dolt tracker into a new Engram project
acceptance: a read-only import preview reports how many open Beads issues map to Engram items, with zero writes, before any apply
rincon-common gets a stable .engram-project and a Central store holding every open Beads issue with provenance, by the same import route as comovo; closed issues stay in Beads as the archive
the cutover happens at a moment with no in-flight bd writes, and AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md then point agents at Engram, under rincon-common's own commit authority
uncommitted code edits in the rincon-common checkout are not turned into tasks and are left to their owners
disposal_reason: Filed prematurely: Greg clarified via Kimi::Consultant (c15db92c #197, 2026-11-15 17:55Z) that rincon-common/comovo on Engram is the future use case motivating sync and EO, not work to open now; no items, owners or planning.
